answer_1.quote: Radiology report generation is a task of generating reports comprising a sequence of sentences.

answer_2.quote: In addition to the NLG metrics, such as BLEU, BERTScore, and ROUGE (Lin, 2004), we deploy a clinical factual accuracy metric ... and Content Ordering (CO) metric ...

answer_4.quote: We conducted a human evaluation to validate the effect of CoPlan. ... Two experts for the JLiverCT and six experts for the MIMIC-CXR dataset who are knowledgeable in radiology reports measured 100 randomly selected reports ...
answer_4.guideline: Annotators measured correctness (F-score between finding labels in generated vs. gold report), fluency (5-point Likert scale for naturalness), and for JLiverCT, content order (normalized Damerau-Levenshtein Distance for positions of findings).
